payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

decision.question: Are both the giraffes and the surrounding environment consistently represented as drawn forms rather than photographic forms beneath a surface effect?
decision.criteria: Pass if drawn contours, interior marks and shading represent the principal subjects and the surrounding vegetation, ground and background, so substantial scene regions no longer rely on photographic surface detail or photographic tonal modeling. Inspect the giraffes' bodies and markings as well as the full environment; sketch-like silhouettes alone do not establish this condition. Fail if substantial regions retain photographic rendering beneath added grain, outlined edges or smudging, even when other regions have been convincingly drawn. Background blur or loss of detail alone does not establish drawn representation. Recognizable anatomy, retained composition, accurate markings, fine drawn detail and retained colors are permitted; source resemblance alone is not evidence of photographic rendering. Return unknown only when the images are unavailable or genuinely insufficient to distinguish the rendering, not merely because evidence differs across regions.
decision.binding: Compare the input and edited images for the requested transformation into a chalk-made drawing, examining the giraffes' bodies and markings as well as the vegetation, ground and background.
